en.title: Xbox Launches New XP Division for Film, TV, and Theme Park Spinoffs
en.summary: Xbox is doubling down on its transmedia strategy with the launch of a new division dedicated to expanding its beloved game universes into film, TV, and even theme parks. This move solidifies their commitment to bringing iconic franchises to audiences beyond the console.
en.body:
Xbox has officially announced the creation of a new business unit, **Xbox XP**, a division laser-focused on developing and managing transmedia extensions for its vast library of gaming intellectual property. This ambitious venture aims to bring franchises like **Halo**, **Gears of War**, and **Minecraft** to life in new formats, including film, television series, and even theme park attractions. The move underscores Xbox's growing confidence in translating its gaming successes into broader entertainment successes, following significant industry trends.

The **Fallout** television series on Amazon Prime Video has already set a high bar, becoming the platform's most successful show since **The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power** and attracting an impressive 65 million viewers. Similarly, the **Minecraft Movie** achieved a strong opening weekend, raking in $157 million globally. These achievements highlight the immense potential for game-based narratives to captivate mainstream audiences. Xbox has been actively managing the licensing of its properties to external production studios, a strategy that has clearly paid dividends. The recent multimedia agreement signed with **Kojima Productions** in September 2026, expanding their partnership to include film and television projects beyond video games for titles like **Physint** and **OD**, further illustrates this forward-thinking approach.

## A Universe of Possibilities

For dedicated fans, the establishment of **Xbox XP** represents a thrilling prospect. It means that the worlds and characters they have spent countless hours with could soon be experienced in entirely new dimensions. Imagine exploring the gritty, post-apocalyptic landscapes of **Gears of War** on the big screen or stepping into the blocky, imaginative realm of **Minecraft** at a dedicated theme park. This expansion offers a chance for deeper engagement with beloved franchises, potentially creating new entry points for casual fans and enriching the lore for long-time enthusiasts. The success of **Fallout** proves that these adaptations can be critically acclaimed and commercially viable when handled with care and respect for the source material.

## What's Next

While specific projects under the **Xbox XP** banner have not yet been fully detailed, the division's formation signals a pipeline of new content to come. Fans can likely expect further announcements regarding film and TV partnerships, building on the momentum of recent successes. The company is also celebrating its 25th anniversary in 2026, a milestone that may see further reveals and celebrations around its iconic franchises.
